note: Invented: the abilities of four roles in a made-up company, Brindle and Oak.

caps.label: Approve orders
caps.hint: May approve an order before it ships

caps.label: Refund
caps.hint: May return money to a customer

caps.label: Edit stock
caps.hint: May change the counts in the stockroom

caps.label: Set prices
caps.hint: May change a price on the shelf or the site

caps.label: Manage staff
caps.hint: May add or remove people from a shop

caps.label: Read reports
caps.hint: May open the weekly sales reports

caps.label: Close the till
caps.hint: May close the day's till and bank it
